name: VBCC
about:
the vbcc C compiler for AmigaOS 68k (vc, vbccm68k, vasm, vlink, the m68k-amigaos
; target) in UP-Term:vbcc, with the VBCC: assign, its path and the VBCC environment variable
copy_comment: ; The drawer userland/vbcc (the author's archives, unmodified, plus UP-Term's config/upterm68k) goes to
; UP-Term:vbcc, the path config/upterm68k and startup.txt name.
welcome: VBCC, the C compiler, for an UP-Term window.
It goes into UP-Term:vbcc; the VBCC: assign
readme_title: the vbcc C compiler for AmigaOS 68k, for UP-Term
readme_contents:
vbcc 0.9h patch2 (vc, vbccm68k, vasm, vlink, the m68k-amigaos target), unmodified from
phoenix.owl.de, with UP-Term's configuration config/upterm68k. It installs in UP-Term:vbcc.
readme_use:
Install adds VBCC: (assign), the path
VBCC:bin and the environment variable VBCC to S:User-Startup, and sets them for the current session.
The Amiga NDK headers are not part of this package (no licence to redistribute them): point NDKINC:
at your Include_H drawer, for example  Assign NDKINC: Work:NDK/Include_H  and then, in a Shell:
  vc +upterm68k hello.c -o hello
source: the author's archives, unmodified: phoenix.owl.de/vbcc/current (upterm-ports pkgs/vbcc)
licenses_notes:
The two lha archives (SHA-256 pinned) are in up-term-src.lha, published next to up-term.lha. Their
  row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/vbcc/SOURCES.txt.
The Amiga NDK is not part of this package.
install_extra: ; VBCC: assigned now and at every boot: a block in S:User-Startup that assigns only while UP-Term:vbcc
; is there, so one left behind by an Uninstall that could not take it out does no harm. The Amiga NDK
; headers are not part of this package: NDKINC: stays the owner's assign (README.txt).
uninstall_extra: ; the VBCC: assign, and this package's block in S:User-Startup (";BEGIN vbcc" to ";END vbcc"):
; UP-Term's unstartup.sh takes out just that block, whatever else was added since. Without it the block
; stays (it does nothing once UP-Term:vbcc is gone) and the message says where it is.
Echo "S:User-Startup still has the lines from ;BEGIN vbcc to ;END vbcc (harmless; delete them by hand)."
